settingsHelp: Optional steps before and after writing. Off by default. Preferences belong to this book and never edit manuscript, Canon or AI context.
alwaysOptional: Every step is optional. You can write without completing the checklist.
limit: Up to 12 steps. Custom items are local checklist text and never run scripts or generate prose.
earlierSaved: The submitted version was saved. Your newer changes still need saving.
endTitle: A quiet close to this writing session
goalHelp: Uses the same daily goal as the writing dashboard. Weekly, volume and book goals are preserved. Use 0 for no daily goal.
goalSaved: Daily goal saved to the writing dashboard.
focusHelp: Leave this optional ritual and open the existing Pomodoro / typewriter controls, skipping any remaining steps. You choose whether to start. This never starts a timer or AI automatically.
focusOpened: Focus tools opened. Choose there whether to start a countdown.
focusNotAutomatic: Opening the panel does not start the Pomodoro. Any existing timer continues unchanged.
reflectionHelp: Record in the existing journal for {{day}} (UTC+08:00), for your own reference only.
existingNote: View the saved journal for this date
reflectionAppend: Append without overwriting the existing journal. The combined note can contain up to 1,000 characters.
reflectionSaved: Appended to the writing dashboard’s journal. Manuscript and word events were not changed.
draftSkipHint: Save this sentence first, or use Skip below to discard it.
rememberSkip: Remember to skip next time (restore in settings)
savingSkipNotice: You can leave now. Submitted saves may still complete; skipping while saving applies to this visit only.
goalConflict: The daily target changed elsewhere. Read the latest target, then review and save. Your input has been retained.
goalRefreshed: Latest target loaded. Your input is retained and still needs confirmation.
goalUnsaved: This target is not saved. Continuing may explicitly skip it; it is never written automatically.
goalSavedState: The current daily target is saved.
closeUnsaved: Some ritual input is not saved
closeUnsavedHelp: Your manuscript is unaffected. Continue editing, or explicitly discard the target / reflection draft before closing.
